title: OpenCode comparison batch 1: local implementation and allocation evidence

method.order: Candidates and baselines ran sequentially, with no concurrent tests/builds. Single allocation profiles are diagnostic, not statistical performance or pool admission evidence.
method.baseline: git show af067d5:packages/agent/src/agent.ts, agent-session.ts and background-shell.ts to identity-recorded temporary .ts siblings; copies of current session/shell benchmarks rewrote only those imports. Other dependencies and built dist stayed constant. Subagent used its --baseline flag. These are targeted runtime comparisons, not a whole clean baseline build.
method.cleanup: All temporary baseline modules and harness copies removed by recorded identity, including the import-failure module. Earlier upstream comparison directory is outside this batch and remains as previously documented.
method.allocations: Notification formatting occurs once per terminal shell task/subagent batch, never per chunk. Only bounded excerpts serialized, <=8 shown, <=8192 UTF-16 code units <=24576 UTF-8 bytes. Existing task retention <=12000 chars; no model summary call, pool, timer or per-notification deferred added. Existing generic Agent queues have no global byte/count cap; this change bounds each managed-task report, not arbitrary extension traffic.
method.prompt: Only prompt constants changed. Real-model summary length/factual quality not measured.
method.codemode: Local tsc dist and real compiled worker.js, not an installed tarball or whole application. Import/WASM phases measured separately; execute includes startup+VM/prelude+bridge+termination. No isolated internal phase or compiled CPU fixture measurement. Each execute has a fresh Worker/VM. Allocation sampling excludes Worker heaps.
method.validation: Full npm test passed. Later custom-tail and post-await cancellation guards were rebuilt and verified using existing session/interaction/compaction/source invariant suites. Final 44 settlement and length-recovery cases pass; preceding targeted 135 and 158 (+1 expected Windows skip) cases passed. No second full suite. Final check and coding-agent build passed. Seven added cases in existing test files, no new test file.
